verdict.rationale: A machine-readable OpenAPI 3.1.0 document titled "Skyvern API" is served at api.skyvern.com/openapi.json and covers run endpoints such as POST /v1/run/tasks. The per-endpoint API reference is generated from that spec, and the deprecation policy marks deprecated endpoints with `deprecated: true` in it. The probe's 404s were only on the skyvern.com marketing domain, so they show a different path rather than contradicting the spec's existence. Missing for 10: discoverability of the spec at standard paths on the main domain, independent hands-on corroboration of downloading and using the spec.
